t: 盎格鲁-祖鲁战争开始.
te: The Anglo-Zulu War begins.
dz: 盎格鲁-祖鲁战争开始.
de: The Anglo-Zulu War begins.

t: 伊桑德勒瓦纳战役取得祖鲁胜利.
te: the Battle of Isandlwana results in a Zulu victory.
dz: 盎格鲁-祖鲁战争:伊桑德勒瓦纳战役取得祖鲁胜利.
de: Anglo-Zulu War:  the Battle of Isandlwana results in a Zulu victory.

t: 罗克漂流之战,距离伊桑德勒瓦纳只有约15公里(9.3米)远,导致英国取胜.
te: the Battle of Rorke's Drift, just some 15 km (9.3 mi) away from Isandlwana, results in a British victory.
dz: 盎格鲁-祖鲁之战:罗克漂流之战,距离伊桑德勒瓦纳只有约15公里(9.3米)远,导致英国取胜.
de: Anglo-Zulu War:  the Battle of Rorke's Drift, just some 15 km (9.3 mi) away from Isandlwana, results in a British victory.

t: 盎格鲁-祖鲁之战:罗克漂流之战结束.
te: The Battle of Rorke's Drift ends.
dz: 盎格鲁-祖鲁之战:罗克漂流之战结束.
de: Anglo-Zulu War: The Battle of Rorke's Drift ends.

t: 保加利亚国家银行成立.
te: The Bulgarian National Bank is founded.
dz: 保加利亚国家银行成立.
de: The Bulgarian National Bank is founded.

t: 英格兰板球队由哈里斯勋爵率领,在悉尼的一场比赛中被暴动所袭击.
te: England's cricket team, led by Lord Harris, is attacked in a riot during a match in Sydney.
dz: 英格兰板球队由哈里斯勋爵率领,在悉尼的一场比赛中被暴动所袭击.
de: England's cricket team, led by Lord Harris, is attacked in a riot during a match in Sydney.

t: 桑福德弗莱明在加拿大皇家研究所的一次会议上首次提议采用通用标准时间。
te: Sandford Fleming first proposes the adoption of Universal Standard Time at a meeting of the Royal Canadian Institute.
dz: 桑福德弗莱明在加拿大皇家研究所的一次会议上首次提议采用通用标准时间。
de: Sandford Fleming first proposes the adoption of Universal Standard Time at a meeting of the Royal Canadian Institute.

t: 当智利军队占领了玻利维亚港口城市安托法加斯塔后,太平洋战争爆发.
te: The War of the Pacific breaks out when the Chilean Army occupies the Bolivian port city of Antofagasta.
dz: 当智利军队占领了玻利维亚港口城市安托法加斯塔后,太平洋战争爆发.
de: The War of the Pacific breaks out when the Chilean Army occupies the Bolivian port city of Antofagasta.

t: 美国总统拉瑟福德·B·海斯 (Rutherford B. Hayes) 签署一项法案，允许女律…
te: US President Rutherford B. Hayes signs a bill allowing female attorneys to argue cases before the Supreme Court of the …
dz: 妇女权利：美国总统拉瑟福德·B·海斯 (Rutherford B. Hayes) 签署一项法案，允许女律师在美国最高法院辩论案件。
de: Women's rights: US President Rutherford B. Hayes signs a bill allowing female attorneys to argue cases before the Supreme Court of the United States.

t: 在纽约的乌蒂克,弗兰克·伍尔沃斯(英语:Frank Woolworth)开通了众多五相和二相通…
te: In Utica, New York, Frank Woolworth opens the first of many of five-and-dime Woolworth stores.
dz: 在纽约的乌蒂克,弗兰克·伍尔沃斯(英语:Frank Woolworth)开通了众多五相和二相通的伍尔沃斯商店中的第一家.
de: In Utica, New York, Frank Woolworth opens the first of many of five-and-dime Woolworth stores.

t: 施泰正式放弃了自己在东京的命令下所担任的"琉球王"的地位,结束了琉球王国.
te: Shō Tai formally abdicates his position of King of Ryūkyū, under orders from Tokyo, ending the Ryukyu Kingdom.
dz: 施泰正式放弃了自己在东京的命令下所担任的"琉球王"的地位,结束了琉球王国.
de: Shō Tai formally abdicates his position of King of Ryūkyū, under orders from Tokyo, ending the Ryukyu Kingdom.

t: 托帕特战役,是第一次战争战役,由智利与玻利维亚和秘鲁联合出击.
te: The Battle of Topáter, the first battle of the war, is fought between Chile and the joint forces of Bolivia and Peru.
dz: 太平洋之战:托帕特战役,是第一次战争战役,由智利与玻利维亚和秘鲁联合出击.
de: War of the Pacific: The Battle of Topáter, the first battle of the war, is fought between Chile and the joint forces of Bolivia and Peru.

t: 坎布拉战役：英国军队击败 20,000 名祖鲁人。
te: Battle of Kambula: British forces defeat 20,000 Zulus.
dz: 盎格鲁-祖鲁战争：坎布拉战役：英国军队击败 20,000 名祖鲁人。
de: Anglo-Zulu War: Battle of Kambula: British forces defeat 20,000 Zulus.

t: 玻利维亚向智利宣战,智利向秘鲁宣战,开始了太平洋战争.
te: Bolivia declares war on Chile, and Chile declares war on Peru, starting the War of the Pacific.
dz: 玻利维亚向智利宣战,智利向秘鲁宣战,开始了太平洋战争.
de: Bolivia declares war on Chile, and Chile declares war on Peru, starting the War of the Pacific.

t: 火烧倒了圣母大学的第二座主楼和穹顶,这促使了第三所和水流,主楼以它的金圆顶来建造.
te: Fire burns down the second main building and dome of the University of Notre Dame, which prompts the construction of th…
dz: 火烧倒了圣母大学的第二座主楼和穹顶,这促使了第三所和水流,主楼以它的金圆顶来建造.
de: Fire burns down the second main building and dome of the University of Notre Dame, which prompts the construction of the third, and current, Main Building with its golden dome.

t: 第一批463名印度契约劳工乘列奥尼达号抵达斐济.
te: The first group of 463 Indian indentured laborers arrives in Fiji aboard the Leonidas.
dz: 第一批463名印度契约劳工乘列奥尼达号抵达斐济.
de: The first group of 463 Indian indentured laborers arrives in Fiji aboard the Leonidas.

t: 两艘智利舰封锁了伊基克港(当时属于秘鲁),在伊基克战役中与两艘秘鲁舰相会战.
te: Two Chilean ships blocking the harbor of Iquique (then belonging to Peru) battle two Peruvian vessels in the Battle of …
dz: 太平洋战争:两艘智利舰封锁了伊基克港(当时属于秘鲁),在伊基克战役中与两艘秘鲁舰相会战.
de: War of the Pacific: Two Chilean ships blocking the harbor of Iquique (then belonging to Peru) battle two Peruvian vessels in the Battle of Iquique.

t: 俄罗斯和联合王国签署"甘达马克条约",建立阿富汗国家.
te: Russia and the United Kingdom sign the Treaty of Gandamak establishing an Afghan state.
dz: 俄罗斯和联合王国签署"甘达马克条约",建立阿富汗国家.
de: Russia and the United Kingdom sign the Treaty of Gandamak establishing an Afghan state.

t: 纽约市吉尔莫的花园被威廉·亨利·范德比尔特更名为麦迪逊广场花园,并在第26街和麦迪逊大道向公众…
te: Gilmore's Garden in New York City is renamed Madison Square Garden by William Henry Vanderbilt and is opened to the pub…
dz: 纽约市吉尔莫的花园被威廉·亨利·范德比尔特更名为麦迪逊广场花园,并在第26街和麦迪逊大道向公众开放.
de: Gilmore's Garden in New York City is renamed Madison Square Garden by William Henry Vanderbilt and is opened to the public at 26th Street and Madison Avenue.

t: 纳波莱昂·欧仁(Napoléon Eugène)是最后一位德意志波拿巴人,在盎格鲁-祖鲁战争中…
te: Napoléon Eugène, the last dynastic Bonaparte, is killed in the Anglo-Zulu War.
dz: 纳波莱昂·欧仁(Napoléon Eugène)是最后一位德意志波拿巴人,在盎格鲁-祖鲁战争中被击毙.
de: Napoléon Eugène, the last dynastic Bonaparte, is killed in the Anglo-Zulu War.

t: 宗格尼山冲突发生在第二次入侵祖鲁王国期间的英军和祖鲁军.
te: The Zungeni Mountain skirmish takes place between British and Zulu forces during the second invasion of the Zulu Kingdo…
dz: 宗格尼山冲突发生在第二次入侵祖鲁王国期间的英军和祖鲁军.
de: The Zungeni Mountain skirmish takes place between British and Zulu forces during the second invasion of the Zulu Kingdom.

t: 查尔斯·塔泽·罗素出版"宗教"杂志"守望台"的第一版.
te: Charles Taze Russell publishes the first edition of the religious magazine The Watchtower.
dz: 查尔斯·塔泽·罗素出版"宗教"杂志"守望台"的第一版.
de: Charles Taze Russell publishes the first edition of the religious magazine The Watchtower.

t: 乌隆地的祖鲁兰都城被英国军队攻克并被焚毁于地,结束了战争并迫使克茨瓦约国王出逃.
te: The Zululand capital of Ulundi is captured by British troops and burned to the ground, ending the war and forcing King …
dz: 盎格鲁-祖鲁战争:乌隆地的祖鲁兰都城被英国军队攻克并被焚毁于地,结束了战争并迫使克茨瓦约国王出逃.
de: Anglo-Zulu War: The Zululand capital of Ulundi is captured by British troops and burned to the ground, ending the war and forcing King Cetshwayo to flee.

t: 航行船USS 珍妮特号从旧金山出发 搭载着一场不祥的北极探险.
te: Sailing ship USS Jeannette departs San Francisco carrying an ill-fated expedition to the North Pole.
dz: 航行船USS 珍妮特号从旧金山出发 搭载着一场不祥的北极探险.
de: Sailing ship USS Jeannette departs San Francisco carrying an ill-fated expedition to the North Pole.

t: 爱尔兰马约郡的肯克当地人 报告说他们看到圣母玛利亚的出现 浮出水面后被取名"我们的敲门女神"(…
te: The locals of Knock, County Mayo, Ireland report their having seen an apparition of the Virgin Mary. The apparition is …
dz: 爱尔兰马约郡的肯克当地人 报告说他们看到圣母玛利亚的出现 浮出水面后被取名"我们的敲门女神"("Our Lady of Knock"),所处地被改造为天主教朝圣地.
de: The locals of Knock, County Mayo, Ireland report their having seen an apparition of the Virgin Mary. The apparition is later named "Our Lady of Knock" and the spot transformed into a Catholic pilgrimage site.

t: 克特斯瓦约是祖鲁人的最后一位国王,被英国人所俘.
te: Cetshwayo, last king of the Zulus, is captured by the British.
dz: 盎格鲁-祖鲁之战:克特斯瓦约是祖鲁人的最后一位国王,被英国人所俘.
de: Anglo-Zulu War: Cetshwayo, last king of the Zulus, is captured by the British.

t: 英国使节路易·卡瓦格尼里爵士和"向导"的72人,在保卫喀布尔的英国留守者时被阿富汗部队屠杀. …
te: British envoy Sir Louis Cavagnari and 72 men of the Guides are massacred by Afghan troops while defending the British R…
dz: 围攻喀布尔的英国留守者:英国使节路易·卡瓦格尼里爵士和"向导"的72人,在保卫喀布尔的英国留守者时被阿富汗部队屠杀. 他们的英雄主义和忠诚在整个大英帝国变得出名并受到崇敬.
de: Siege of the British Residency in Kabul: British envoy Sir Louis Cavagnari and 72 men of the Guides are massacred by Afghan troops while defending the British Residency in Kabul. Their heroism and loyalty became famous and revered throughout the British Empire.
p: Siege of the British Residency in Kabul

t: 马塞多-罗马尼亚文化会成立.
te: The Macedo-Romanian Cultural Society is founded.
dz: 马塞多-罗马尼亚文化会成立.
de: The Macedo-Romanian Cultural Society is founded.

t: 智利海军在安加摩斯战役中击败了秘鲁海军.
te: The Chilean Navy defeats the Peruvian Navy in the Battle of Angamos.
dz: 太平洋之战:智利海军在安加摩斯战役中击败了秘鲁海军.

t: 托马斯·爱迪生为其白炽灯泡设计申请专利。
te: Thomas Edison applies for a patent for his design for an incandescent light bulb.
dz: 托马斯·爱迪生为其白炽灯泡设计申请专利。
de: Thomas Edison applies for a patent for his design for an incandescent light bulb.

t: 托马斯·爱迪生使用碳化线灯丝测试了第一个实用的白炽电灯泡；灯泡在烧坏前持续了 131⁄2 小时。
te: Using a filament of carbonized thread, Thomas Edison tests the first practical electric incandescent light bulb; the bu…
dz: 托马斯·爱迪生使用碳化线灯丝测试了第一个实用的白炽电灯泡；灯泡在烧坏前持续了 131⁄2 小时。
de: Using a filament of carbonized thread, Thomas Edison tests the first practical electric incandescent light bulb; the bulb lasted 131⁄2 hours before burning out.

te: Battle of Tarapacá: The confrontation between the Chilean Army and the Peruvian Army takes place in Tarapacá, the Peruv…
dz: 太平洋战争:塔拉帕卡战役: 智利军队和秘鲁军队的对峙发生在塔拉帕卡,秘鲁的胜利由两位将领相继被击毙,智利将领被俘,以秘鲁将领胡安·布恩迪亚·诺雷吉亚为首.
de: War of the Pacific: Battle of Tarapacá: The confrontation between the Chilean Army and the Peruvian Army takes place in Tarapacá, the Peruvian victory is consummated with the death of the 2 generals and the capture the Chilean general in said place of battle, headed by the Peruvian victory of General Juan Buendía y Noregia.

t: 诺拉·赫尔默的虚构角色最早由贝蒂·亨宁斯在丹麦皇家剧院的"一朵花"(A Doll's Hous…

de: the fictional character of Nora Helmer is first portrayed by Betty Hennings at a showing of A Doll's House at the Royal Danish Theatre.

t: 位于苏格兰邓迪的Tay Rail Bridge的中心部分,英国在一列火车经过时倒塌,造成75人…

dz: Tay Bridge灾难:位于苏格兰邓迪的Tay Rail Bridge的中心部分,英国在一列火车经过时倒塌,造成75人死亡.
de: Tay Bridge disaster: The central part of the Tay Rail Bridge in Dundee, Scotland, United Kingdom collapses as a train passes over it, killing 75.
